an astrological division of the day (these Karaṇas are eleven, viz. वव, वलव, कौलव, तैतिल, गर, वणिज, विष्टि, शकुनि, चतुष्पद, किन्तुघ्न, and नाग, two being equal to a lunar day; the first seven are called अ-ध्रुवाणि or movable, and fill, eight times repeated, the space from the second half of the first day in the moon's increase to the first half of the fourteenth day in its wane; the four others are ध्रुवाणि or fixed, and occupy the four half-days from the second half of the fourteenth day in the wane of the moon to the first half of the first day in its increase), VarBṛS.; Suśr. &c.

s: strI, (karANgulIBirmAlayeva japanAt kararUpA mAlA । karANgulya mAleva vA .) karaparbbarUpamAlA । yaTA, “anAmikAtrayaM parbba kanizWAtritayaM taTA । tarjjanImUlaparyyantaM karamAlA prakIrttitA” ॥ iti muRqamAlAtantre sAmAnyavizayam ॥ * ॥ “tarjjanI maDyamAnAmA kanizWA ceti tAH kramAt । tisro'NgulyastriparbbARo maDyamA cEkaparbbikA । parbbadvayaM maDyamAyA merutvenopakalpayet” ॥ iti SivarahasyIyaM SaktiBinnavizayam ॥ * ॥ “anAmAmUlamAraBya kanizWAdikrameRa tu । tarjjanImaDyaparyyantamazwaparbbasu saMjapet” ॥ iti sanatkumArasaMhitAvacanaM SaktItarezAmazwavAravizayam ॥ * ॥ “anAmikAtrayaM parbba kanizWA ca triparbbikA । maDyamAyASca tritayaM tarjjanImUlaparbbikA ॥ karamAlA samAKyAtA AraByAnAmikAntarAt । tarjjanyagre taTA maDye yo japet sa tu pApakft” ॥ iti Saktivizaye muRqamAlAtantram ॥ * ॥ taTA । “anAmAmUlamAraBya prAdakziRyakrameRa tu । maDyamAmUlaparyyantaM japedazwasu parbbasu” ॥ idamapi Saktivizaye azwavAraparam । iti SyAmArahasyam ॥
v: stro karaH karANguliparva mAleva japasaMKyAhetutvAt । “AraByAnAmikAmaDyaM dakziRAvarttayogataH । tarjanImUlaparyyantaM karamAlA prakIrttitA” ityuktalakzaRAyAM japasaMKyArTaM karANguliparvarUpAyAM mAlAyAm । atra viSezastantrasA॰ uktaH yaTA sanatkumArasaMhitAyAm “tarjjanI maDyamAnAmA kanizWA ceti tAH kramAt । tisro'NgulyastriparvARo maDyamA cEkaparvikA । parvadvayaM saDyamAyA merutvenopakalpayet” । kramamAha tatrEva “anAmAmaDyamAraBya kanizWAdita eva ca । tarjanImUlaparyyantaM daSaparvasu saM japet” । tatrEva । “anAmAmUlamAraBya kanizWAdita eva ca । tarjanImaDyaparyyantamazwaparvasu saMjapet” । etadvacanantu azwottaraSatavizayam vizRuvizayaYca । Saktivizaye punaH “anAmikAtrayaM parva kanizWA ca triparvikA । maDyamAyASca tritayaM tarjjanImUlaparvaRi । tarjanyagre taTA maDye yo japet sa tu pApahft” । anyacca “avAmAmUlamAraBya prAdakziRyakrameRa ca । maDyamAmUlaparyyantaM saMjapedazwaparvasu” । idamapi azwottaraSatavizayam । haMsapArameSvare “rpavatrayamanAmAyAH parivarttona vE kramAt । parvatrayaM maDyamAyAstarjanyekaM samAhareta । parvadvayantu tarjjanyAH meruMtadvidDi pArvati! । SaktimAlA samAKyAtA sarvatantrapradIpitA । SrIvidyAyAmayaM viSezaH । “anAmAmUlamAraBya prAdakziRyakrameRa ca । maDyamAmUlaparyyantaM daSaparvasu saMjapet” । anyacca “maDyamAyA anAmAyA mUlAgraYca dvayaM dvayam । kanizWAyASca tarjjanyAstrayaM parva maheSvari! । anAmAmaDyamayoSca meruHsyAt dvitayaM SuBam । prAdakziRyakramAddevi । japet tripurasundarImiti” yAmalAt “kanizWAmUlamAraBya prAdakziRyakrameRa tu । tarjjanImUlaparyyantaM japadazwasu parvasu” iti SrIkramavacanAcca । idamapi taTEva । muRqamAlAtantre “anAmikAdvayaM parva kanizWAdikrameRa tu । tarjanImUlaparyyattaM karamAlA prakIrttitA । aNgalIM na viyuYjIta kiYcidAkuYcite tale । aNgulInAM viyogAcca CidrAcca sravate japaH” । anyatrApi । “aNgulyagre ca yajjaptaM yajjaptaM merulaNGane । parvasanDizu yajjaptaM tatsarvaM nizPalaM Bavet । gaRanAviDimullaNGya yo japet tajjapaM yataH । gfhRanti rAkzasAstena gaRayet sarvaTA buDaH । japasaMKyA tu karttavyA nAsaMKyAtaM japet suDIH । asaMKyAkArakasyAsya sarvaM Bavati nizPalam । hfdaye hastamAropya tiryyak kftvA karANgulIH । AcCAdya vAsamA hastO dakziRena sadA japet” । gAyatrIjape viSezaH viDAnapA॰ gAyatrIhfdaye “anAmikAmaDyareKAvaDyaDaH prakrameRa ca । tarjjanTAdigatAnte ca akzamAlA kare sTitA” anAmikAyA maDyareKAmAdiM kftvA tarjanyA AdireKA ante yasyAH seyaM kare sTitA mAletyarTaH viGAnapA॰ । tatrEva yamaH । “sahasraparamAM devIM SatamaDyAM daSAbarAm । gAyatrIM tu japennitTaM sarvakalamazanASinIm । parvaBistu japeddevImanyatrAniyamaH smftaH । gAyatryAvedavIjatvAt gaditaM brahmaRA svayam । aNgazWAgreRa yajjaptaM bajjaptaM merulaNGatAt । asaMKyAtaM taTA japtaM tatmarvaM nizPalaM Bavet” madanapArijAte tu maDyamAyA dvayaM parvetipAWaH । A॰ ta॰ SaNKaH । “tisro'NgulyastriparvvARo maDyamA cEkaparvikA । anAmAmaDyamAraBya japa evamudAhftaH” kAgye mAlA'BAve evAsyAgrAhyatA nitye tu sarvaTEva grAhyatA yaTAha yoginIta॰ । “nityaM japaM kare kuryyAnnakAmyamavaroDanAt । kAmyamapi kare kuryyAt mAlA'BAve priyaMvade! । tatrANgulyA japaM kuryyAt sANguzWANguliBirjapet । aNguzWena vinA karma kftaM tannizPalaM Bavet” utpattitantre 1 pa॰ “nityaM nEmittikaM kAmyaM kare kuryyAdvicakzaRaH । karamAlA mahAdevi! sarvadozavivarjitA । CinnaBinnAdidozo'pi kare nAsti kadAcana । akzayA tu kare devi! mAlA Bavati tAdfSI । granTiH sA kuRqalISaktiH paYcASadvarRRarUgiRI । ataeva maheSAni! karamAlA mahAPalA” । tataSca dakziReneti prAgukteH dakzahastaparvamireva daSasaMKyajapaH kAryyaH । SatAdijape tu dakziRahastena kftajapadaSasaMKyAyAH pratyekaM daSakasaMKyAgaRanA vAmahastasTitanirddizwaparvvakrameRa kAryyA taTA ca daSakasya daSakena gaRane SatasaMKyApUrttiH । aDikAzwa saMKyA tu dakzahasternava prAguktarItya kAryyoti tattvam ।
